title.zh: 将北伊罗戈省索尔索纳市镇纳格帕特帕坦小学的名称变更为Hilario Valdez纪念社区学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Nagpatpatan Elementary School in the Municipality of Solsona, Province of Ilocos Norte, to Hilario Valdez Memorial Community School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Nagpatpatan Elementary School in the Municipality of Solsona, Province of Ilocos Norte, to Hilario Valdez Memorial Community School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5303_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Nagpatpatan Elementary School in the Municipality of Solsona, Province of Ilocos Norte, is hereby changed to Hilario Valdez Memorial Community School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
